title: Tail hydration request burst while a session streams: identical ?tail=20 fetched dozens of times per second-scale window
outcome: A local session that is streaming does not cause repeated identical tail requests, whether or not it is the selected pane. Sessions outside the owner's domain (remote sessions, deltas without a body sequence and epoch) keep master's repair retry, tracked under w-5dae8178b905.
acceptance: A note records the reproduction result on master d705038: the two legacy cases, the classification of each answer, and that no redundant queued fetch occurs.
The residual legacy retry cycle is recorded on w-5dae8178b905 with the two cases.
